desktopOnly.title: DoU subscription
desktopOnly.appTitle: On a phone, subscribe in the app
desktopOnly.appBody: In the DoU app, go to MY › Subscription to subscribe through the App Store or Google Play.
desktopOnly.pcTitle: Subscribe on the web from a computer
desktopOnly.pcBody: Open this page in a desktop browser to subscribe with web payment. Either way, your subscription works on both your phone and your PC.

paymentWindow.title: Add a card
paymentWindow.description: This is a test payment window and takes no real card details. Pick an outcome.

common.placeholder: The {{id}} screen is on its way

plans.title: DoU plans
plans.subtitle: The same plans at the same prices as in the app. A first subscription starts with a {{days}}-day free trial, then renews monthly.
plans.subtitleTrialUsed: You have already used the free trial. Subscribing charges you today and renews on the same day each month.
plans.changeSubtitle: You can move one step up or down from your current plan.
plans.entryHint: Your first subscription starts with {{plan}}. Upgrade after subscribing for more clouds.

notes.trialOnce: The free trial is offered once, to an account's first subscription.
notes.afterTrial: After the trial, you are charged on the same day each month, and you can cancel at any time.
notes.storeSubscribers: If you already subscribe in the app (App Store or Google Play), you are not charged again on the web.
notes.trialUsed: The free trial is limited to one per account, and this account has already used it in the app or on the web.
notes.chargeToday: You are charged today, and this day (day {{day}} of each month) becomes your billing day. You can cancel at any time.
notes.startAtEntry: Your first subscription starts with {{plan}}. Upgrade after subscribing for more clouds.

changeUnavailable.title: You can't change your plan right now
changeUnavailable.body: Check your subscription first. Once a payment issue or a scheduled cancellation or change is settled, you can change it again.

storeBilled.title: You subscribe in the app
storeBilled.body: Change your plan in the store you subscribed through.

login.title: Sign in
login.body: Sign in with the account you use in the DoU app. Your subscription applies to that account's app.
login.phoneTitle: Signed up with a phone number only?
login.phoneBody: Link a Google or Apple account in the app under MY › Account first, then sign in here.
login.noNewAccounts: New accounts are not created on the web.

reason.expired-attempt: The sign-in timed out. Please try again
reason.failed: We couldn't sign you in. Please try again
reason.session-ended: You were signed out. Please sign in again

noAccount.title: No DoU account found
noAccount.bodyHint: No DoU account is linked to {{hint}} ({{provider}}). Install the app, sign in with the same account, then come back.
noAccount.body: No DoU account is linked to this {{provider}} account. Install the app, sign in with the same account, then come back.
noAccount.step2: Sign in to the app with the same {{provider}} account
noAccount.step3: Sign in again on this page
noAccount.otherWaysTitle: Already signed up in the app?
noAccount.phoneUser: If you signed up with a phone number, link your {{provider}} account in the app under MY › Account first.
noAccount.otherProvider: If you sign in to the app another way, sign in here that way instead.
noAccount.appStore: Get it on the App Store

storeManaged.title: You subscribe in the app
storeManaged.body: This account subscribes through {{store}}, so it is not billed on the web. Change or cancel your plan in the store you subscribed through.

howTo.appStore: iPhone Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions › DoU
howTo.googlePlay: Play Store app › Profile › Payments & subscriptions › Subscriptions › DoU

storeManaged.moveToWeb: To move to the web, cancel in the store and subscribe here once the paid period ends. There is no free trial then.

details.title: Review your order
details.subtitle: Check the plan, the price and the account the subscription applies to.
details.accountTitle: This applies to this account's DoU app
details.accountNote: If this is not the account you use in the app, sign out and sign in again with that one.

billing.title: Billing details
billing.countryNote: The billing country decides how you pay. It cannot be changed after you subscribe.
billing.comingSoonTitle: Paying from outside Korea is coming soon
billing.comingSoonBody: For now you can subscribe only with South Korea as the billing country.

email.codeSent: Enter the code we sent to {{address}}.

error.invalidCode: That code does not match. Please check it and try again.
error.limit: You cannot add more billing emails. Remove one you no longer use in Billing info.

consent.terms: I agree to the Terms of Service
consent.privacy: I agree to the collection and use of personal information
consent.autoRenew: I have read how automatic payment works
consent.noticeTrial: From {{date}}, when the trial ends, {{price}} is charged to your card on day {{day}} of every month. You can cancel at any time, and cancelling during the trial means you are not charged.
consent.noticePaid: {{price}} is charged today, and the same amount on day {{day}} of every month to your card. You can cancel at any time.

payment.title: Add a payment method
payment.subtitleTrial: Your free trial starts once a card is added. Nothing is charged today.
payment.subtitlePaid: Once a card is added, {{price}} is charged and your subscription starts.
payment.cardNote: You enter your card in the payment provider's window. DoU does not store card numbers.
payment.windowTitle: Korean card payment window (shown by the payment provider)
payment.windowSteps: Card issuer · Card number · Expiry · First 2 digits of PIN · Identity check
payment.ctaTrial: Add card and start free trial
payment.renewTrial: From {{date}}, {{price}} is charged on day {{day}} of every month. You can cancel at any time in subscription management.
payment.renewPaid: From today, {{price}} is charged on day {{day}} of every month. You can cancel at any time in subscription management.

error.limit: Too many card attempts. Please try again later.
error.conflict: This subscription cannot be started right now. Check your current subscription in subscription management.

processing.body: Please wait a moment without closing or reloading this window.
processing.bodyUpgrade: Please wait a moment without closing this window. Once the payment goes through, you are on {{plan}}.
processing.waitBody: Even if you close this window, you can see the result in subscription management.

retried.title: Payment complete
retried.body: Your subscription is back to normal. You are still billed on day {{day}} of every month.

body.card: The payment window was closed, so no subscription was created. Nothing was charged.
body.payment: The payment window was closed, so no subscription was created. Nothing was charged.
body.upgrade: The payment window was closed, so your plan did not change. Nothing was charged.
body.retry: The payment window was closed, so nothing was charged. Your subscription's payment is still overdue.

title.card: We could not add your card

body.card: No subscription was created and nothing was charged.
body.payment: No subscription was created and nothing was charged.
body.upgrade: Nothing was charged and you stay on {{plan}}.
body.retry: Nothing was charged and your subscription's payment is still overdue.

reason.attemptLimit: Too many card attempts. Please try again later.
reason.unknown: The payment provider could not complete the payment. Please try again later.

reasonNext.register: Add another card, or contact your card issuer.
reasonNext.pay: Pay with another card, or contact your card issuer.

failed.retryStillDue: You can change your payment method, or pay again with the same card.

complete.appliedTo: Your subscription is already applied to the DoU app of {{account}}.

appSetup.title: Set up your clouds in the app
appSetup.check: Check your {{plan}} subscription in MY › Subscription

complete.setUpInApp: Set up clouds in the app
complete.upgradedBodyPaid_one: {{price}} was charged, and you can now create up to {{count}} cloud.
complete.upgradedBodyPaid_other: {{price}} was charged, and you can now create up to {{count}} clouds.
complete.upgradedBodyFree_one: Nothing was charged during your trial, and you can now create up to {{count}} cloud.
complete.upgradedBodyFree_other: Nothing was charged during your trial, and you can now create up to {{count}} clouds.
complete.addInApp: Add a cloud in the app

chooseClouds.title: Choose the clouds to keep in the app
chooseClouds.body_one: After the change you can use up to {{count}} cloud. Before it takes effect, choose the clouds to keep in the DoU app under MY › Subscription.
chooseClouds.body_other: After the change you can use up to {{count}} clouds. Before it takes effect, choose the clouds to keep in the DoU app under MY › Subscription.

change.sameDay: A scheduled change takes effect today, so the plan cannot be changed. Please try again tomorrow.

error.conflict: The plan cannot be changed right now. Check the subscription's status.

ending.title: A subscription that is ending cannot change plan
ending.body: Undo the cancellation on the subscription page, then try again.

upgrade.title: Confirm upgrade
upgrade.subtitlePaid: Pay the difference today and start using {{plan}} right away.
upgrade.subtitleFree: Nothing is charged today during your trial. You can use {{plan}} right away.
upgrade.pendingBody: Upgrading cancels the change scheduled for {{date}}, and you use {{plan}} from today.
upgrade.prorationNote: The difference covers what is left of the current billing period.
upgrade.asideClouds_one: You can create up to {{count}} cloud
upgrade.asideClouds_other: You can create up to {{count}} clouds
upgrade.asideApp: New clouds are added in the app
upgrade.asideFailure: If the payment fails, your plan stays as it is and you are pointed to your payment methods

downgrade.title: Schedule a downgrade
downgrade.subtitle: You move to {{plan}} on the next payment date. Nothing is charged now.
downgrade.keepTitle: Only {{to}} of your {{from}} clouds stay active
downgrade.keepBody: Before the change takes effect, choose the clouds to keep in the app. Clouds you do not choose are not deleted; they are made inactive.
downgrade.asideBody: Your clouds are listed in the app, so you choose them there. You can cancel the scheduled change at any time on the subscription page.

pastDue.title: Change plan
pastDue.bannerTitle: Please pay the overdue amount first
pastDue.bannerBody: The {{date}} payment ({{price}}) failed, so the plan cannot be changed. Update your card and pay, then you can change plan.
pastDue.bannerBodyNoDate: A payment failed, so the plan cannot be changed. Update your card and pay, then you can change plan.

paymentMethods.title: Payment methods
paymentMethods.subtitle: From the next payment on, your default card is charged.

empty.title: No cards yet
empty.body: Add a card and the next payment is charged to it.

notes.title: Good to know
notes.removeDefault: To remove your default card, make another card the default first.
notes.removeLast: While subscribed you can't remove your last card — add a new one, then swap.
notes.domestic: Only cards issued in Korea can be added for now.
notes.noCharge: Adding a card only registers it — nothing is charged.

declined.title: We couldn't add the card
declined.body: The card issuer declined it. Try another card or contact your issuer.

attemptLimit.title: Too many attempts
attemptLimit.body: Please try again in a little while.

expiring.title: Your default card expires before the next payment
expiring.body: {{card}} expires in {{expiry}}. Add a new card and make it the default before the {{date}} payment.
expiring.bodyNoDate: {{card}} expires in {{expiry}}. Add a new card and make it the default.

pastDue.title_one: {{amount}} overdue · {{count}} day until access is restricted
pastDue.title_other: {{amount}} overdue · {{count}} days until access is restricted
pastDue.titleToday: {{amount}} overdue · access is restricted from today
pastDue.body: Add a new card or make another card the default, and the overdue amount is charged right away.

addDialog.body: This only registers a card — nothing is charged. You enter the card details in the payment provider's window.

defaultDialog.title: Change your default card?
defaultDialog.body: From the next payment ({{date}} · {{amount}}), {{card}} is charged.
defaultDialog.bodyNoNext: From the next payment, {{card}} is charged.

removeDialog.title: Remove {{card}}?
removeDialog.body: To use it again you'd have to add it again.

cannotRemoveDefault.title: Your default card can't be removed yet
cannotRemoveDefault.body: Make another card the default, then remove this one.

cannotRemoveLast.title: Your last card can't be removed
cannotRemoveLast.body: A subscription needs a card to charge. Add a new card, then remove this one.

history.subtitle: Your payments and refunds. Receipts are card receipts issued by the payment provider.

empty.title: No payments yet
empty.trial: You're on a free trial. The first payment ({{amount}}) is on {{date}}.

history.taxNote: Card payments are not issued a separate tax invoice.

info.title: Billing info
info.subtitle: Where payment and billing emails go, and your billing country.

bounced.body: Mail sent to {{address}} came back. Check the address or make another email the primary one.

country.label: Billing country
country.note: The billing country decides how you are charged, so it can't be changed. To change it, cancel and subscribe again.

removeDialog.title: Remove {{address}}?
removeDialog.body: Billing emails will no longer go to this address.
